definitions.explanation: Understanding and accepting something; giving one's agreement or acknowledgment.
An acknowledgment that a message has been received and understood, commonly used in professional/military contexts.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is an ordinary noun: the consent or approval of a person who has authority over the matter. It is what you {了解|りょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (obtain) before acting.

Sense 2 is the one-word reply "understood / got it", heard in workplaces, on radio, and in messaging apps. As a reply it is a complete utterance on its own.

POLITENESS LEVELS:
Replies of acknowledgment form a clear ladder, and choosing the wrong rung is a common learner mistake:
- {了解|りょうかい} - bare, plain; between colleagues and friends, or to a subordinate
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ - lightly polite; the everyday chat and messaging form
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ - polite, but see the caution below
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ - humble; the safe choice toward a superior or a customer
- ⟦かしこまりました→かしこまりました：19682_kashikomarimashita⟧ - the most deferential; service-industry standard

WATCH OUT:
{了解|りょうかい} is not itself a humble word. Many Japanese workplaces treat even {了解|りょうかい}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ as too casual toward a superior or a client, and expect ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ instead. The rule is not universal - some companies find it fussy - but a learner is safer defaulting to {承知|しょうち}しました upward and keeping {了解|りょうかい} for peers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to understand, to consent)
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain consent)
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to seek consent)
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦なし→無し：03779_nashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (without consent)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧ - understanding, with the added sense of accepting what is asked; the humble counterpart
- ⟦{分|わ}かりました→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ - neutral "I understand"; safe in most situations but weaker as an acknowledgment of an instruction
- ⟦かしこまりました→かしこまりました：19682_kashikomarimashita⟧ - very formal; a shop assistant or hotel clerk answering a customer
